From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Jordan — good questions. Quick answers and a short pre-lab runbook snippet below. See also our shared onboarding doc: https://redwood-internal.sharepoint.com/sites/marketplace/ACME_ONBOARDING

1) Container registry: For the lab were fine with either approach. If you want to keep images private, grant the test SP Pull permission on your ACR (role: AcrPull). Well show both flows during the lab (private ACR pull + public test image).

2) SP permissions: AcrPull + "Contributor" on the subscription is overkill for long-term. For the lab the minimal set that works:
- AcrPull on the ACR resource
- Microsoft.Marketplace/Offers/Write on the publisher resource (temporary during test)
- Microsoft.Resources/deployments/write for the deploy step

Pre-lab commands (Azure CLI) your infra team can run to validate before Wed:
- az login --service-principal -u <APP_ID> -p <PASSWORD> --tenant <TENANT_ID>
- az acr repository show --name <ACR_NAME> --image <REPO>:<TAG>
- az role assignment list --assignee <APP_ID> --scope /subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourceGroups/<RG>

Runbook excerpt (well walk through these):
- Verify publisher account identity in Partner Center
- Create test SP and grant AcrPull to ACR, and a scoped "Marketplace publisher" permission to the publisher resource
- Push or allow pull of sample image and validate via az acr repository show
- Create a draft offer in the portal and attempt a test publish to the staging catalog

Ive attached the blank SOW template for co-sell paperwork and added a few notes inline in acme_sow.pdf.

Attachments: acme_sow.pdf

See you Wed 07/23 09:30 PDT — well use the following Teams link (will send in calendar invite).

— Marissa Cole
Technical Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
